$comment: Page-weight budgets for the documentation site, checked in CI by scripts/verify-page-weight.php. Recalibrated on 2026-11-05 for SIMAI Framework ui-c3015f76bcc2, whose core.js grew from 727 KB to 1.12 MB: 167 pages, median 4.28 MB, heaviest ordinary pages 5.39 MB (ru/components/layout/surface/) and 5.24 MB (ru/project-demos/, ru/development/composition/). First calibrated on 2026-10-20 (main 57686108). Static estimate; headless Chrome loads 0.5-0.9 MB more per page (Framework chunks a script loads, icon weights picked at run time). On 2026-11-05 the English pages got their own budgets beside the Russian ones (259 pages). Recalibrated on 2026-11-15 for SIMAI Framework ui-141822273efe, whose role tokens and core styles 1.13 grew the shared sheets (core.css 308 KB to 332 KB, core.min.js 522 KB to 536 KB, and the role variables in each Smart sheet): median 4.38 MB; the surface, composition and example-gallery pages crossed their budgets by 0.03-0.13 MB. Remeasured on 2026-11-15 for Docara 3.15.0, whose shell stylesheets take two and a half times their distinct bytes and carry the brand, navigation and preferences styles: ordinary pages stay within 8 KB of before (median 4.37 MB), but a page that embeds a whole demonstrator page in its example frame shares fewer of its larger shell sheets with that frame and grows by about 0.2 MB; region-aside and smart-alert crossed the default. Recalibrated on 2026-11-19 for SIMAI Framework ui-dc9fc39aeb26 (Docara 3.18.0), whose component sheets about doubled (menu.min.css 280 KB to 567 KB, buttons.min.css 287 KB to 525 KB, icon-buttons.min.css 182 KB to 312 KB, core.css 332 KB to 497 KB) and whose menu now draws the header on every page: median 6.30 MB (was 4.38 MB), heaviest ordinary page 7.01 MB (ru/components/layout/landing-blocks/); the example pages count their frame's shell sheets again and reach 7.5-8.2 MB. Over the network the shell sheets travel gzip-compressed (about a tenth: 346 KB for the 3.3 MB of a docs page) with a one-year immutable cache, and example frames load lazily. Lower the budgets again when the Framework sheets shrink.
